verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents an official hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to project data. Connected agents can query events, funnels, flows, retention and session replays in natural language, and can take write actions such as Create-Dashboard; a probe independently confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: documented connection/authentication setup steps and supported clients, and independent hands-on corroboration of the server working in practice.
